_about: A model of domains for a data mesh. Each domain has admins, contributors ("everyone", "specific users or groups" with a list, or "admins only"), workspaces and subdomains. Subdomains list their workspaces and, if they could have any, admins.
needs: A Sales domain owned by Priya, the business owner, and a Finance domain owned by Omar.
Sales EMEA as a subdomain of Sales, for the EMEA workspaces. Lukas runs EMEA and asked to be its admin.
Only the Sales workspace admins group may add workspaces to Sales.
Workspaces: Sales-Core to Sales, Sales-EMEA-Reports to Sales EMEA, Finance-GL to Finance.
